item.description: Dhurandhar continues to hold well at the box office. The spy action drama added another Rs. 10.75 crore on its 4th Wednesday, maintaining a steady run on the weekdays. The 4th week's cume reached Rs. 87.50 crore in 6 days. It is expected to record a spike on New Year, which would take the 4th week to Rs. 100 crore mark.
